diseases.name: Rice Blast
diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with ash-colored centers and brown margins on leaves; rotting of neck node (neck blast) causing panicle breakage.
diseases.prevention_methods: Seed treatment with carbendazim (2 g/kg); avoid split nitrogen overuse; balanced silica nutrition.
diseases.biological_management: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 2.5 g/L at early tillering.
diseases.cultural_management: Keep bunds weed-free; avoid water stagnation followed by severe soil cracking.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray tricyclazole 75 WP (0.6 g/L) or isoprothiolane 40 EC (1.5 ml/L) at boot leaf to heading stage.

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight of Rice
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked to yellowish-white stripes starting from leaf tips and margins; milky bacterial ooze under humid morning conditions (Kresek phase).
diseases.prevention_methods: Grow resistant varieties (IR 64, Swarna Sub1); seed soaking in streptocycline solution (0.015%).
diseases.biological_management: Application of bioagents Bacillus velezensis or Pseudomonas fluorescens.
diseases.cultural_management: Drain excess stagnant field water; temporarily discontinue nitrogen top-dressing.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray copper hydroxide 53.8 DF (1.5 g/L) or copper oxychloride (2.5 g/L) + streptocycline (100 mg/L).

diseases.name: Rice Brown Spot
diseases.symptoms: Dark brown, circular to oval sesame seed-like spots scattered across leaf blades; discolored grains.
diseases.prevention_methods: Seed treatment with mancozeb (3 g/kg); correct soil potassium, zinc, and micronutrient deficiencies.
diseases.biological_management: Trichoderma viride seed and soil application.
diseases.cultural_management: Ensure balanced nutrition and avoid severe moisture stress during tillering.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Foliar spray of mancozeb 75 WP (2 g/L) or edifenphos 50 EC (1 ml/L).

diseases.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust
diseases.symptoms: Yellowish-orange pustules arranged in linear parallel stripes on leaf blades, powdery urediniospores on touch.
diseases.prevention_methods: Sow rust-resistant varieties (HD 2967, HD 3086, DBW 187); timely sowing before mid-November.
diseases.biological_management: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L; application of bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis.
diseases.cultural_management: Avoid late sowing; eradicate alternate weed hosts; avoid excess nitrogen.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L (200 ml in 200L water/acre) at first appearance.

diseases.name: Karnal Bunt

diseases.cultural_management: Practice crop rotation with non-host crops (gram, mustard); avoid excess irrigation at flowering.

diseases.name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight
diseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical, cigar-shaped greyish-green to tan lesions (2.5 to 15 cm) running parallel to leaf veins.
diseases.prevention_methods: Plant resistant hybrids; seed treatment with thiram or captan (2.5 g/kg seed).
diseases.biological_management: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5 g/L.
diseases.cultural_management: Crop rotation with non-graminaceous crops (soybean, groundnut) and residue burial.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray azoxystrobin 18.2% + difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L or mancozeb 75 WP (2.5 g/L).

diseases.name: Maize Common Rust
diseases.symptoms: Golden-brown to cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
diseases.prevention_methods: Sow resistant cultivars; avoid very late winter planting in cool climates.
diseases.biological_management: Conserve natural hyperparasites like Darluca filum.
diseases.cultural_management: Maintain optimal plant spacing to allow sun penetration and air movement.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) or mancozeb (2 g/L) at first symptom appearance.

diseases.name: Maize Gray Leaf Spot
diseases.symptoms: Narrow, rectangular, tan lesions strictly confined between leaf veins giving a windowpane effect.
diseases.prevention_methods: Select resistant hybrids; practice 2-year crop rotation.
diseases.biological_management: Spray Bacillus amyloliquefaciens @ 5 ml/L.
diseases.cultural_management: Tillage to bury infested corn stubble.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Foliar application of pyraclostrobin 20 WG (0.5 g/L) or tebuconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L).

diseases.name: Soybean Rust
diseases.symptoms: Polygonal chlorotic-to-tan foliar lesions on lower leaves with tiny volcanic pustules releasing reddish-brown urediniospores.
diseases.prevention_methods: Sow early-maturing varieties; avoid excessive plant densities; inspect lower canopy weekly.
diseases.biological_management: Spray Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L during early vegetative stage.
diseases.cultural_management: Intercropping with maize or pigeon pea to reduce spore drift.

diseases.cultural_management: Rogue out and destroy infected plants within first 30 days of sowing.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray thiamethoxam 25 WG (0.2 g/L) or acetamiprid 20 SP (0.3 g/L) when whitefly exceeds threshold (5-10/leaf).

diseases.name: Soybean Frogeye Leaf Spot

diseases.prevention_methods: Use certified clean seed and rotate with non-host crops.
diseases.biological_management: Spray Bacillus subtilis @ 5 g/L.
diseases.cultural_management: Bury crop residues by deep summer ploughing.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Foliar spray of azoxystrobin 18.2% + difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 1 ml/L at onset of podding.

diseases.name: Bacterial Blight of Cotton
diseases.symptoms: Angular water-soaked leaf spots bordered by veins, blackening of veins (black arm), and seedling blight.
diseases.prevention_methods: Acid delinting of seed with concentrated H2SO4 (100 ml/kg seed) and use of certified resistant hybrids.
diseases.biological_management: Seed biopriming with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed.
diseases.cultural_management: Crop rotation with non-host cereals (jowar, bajra); eradication and burning of infected crop residue.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray copper oxychloride 50 WP (2.5 g/L) mixed with streptocycline (100 mg/L) at early foliar symptom onset.

diseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
diseases.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, thick enation veins beneath leaves, stunted plant height, and poor boll formation.
diseases.prevention_methods: Eradicate alternate weed hosts (Abutilon indicum); plant resistant Bt hybrids; install yellow sticky traps.
diseases.biological_management: Encourage natural predators of whitefly like Chrysoperla carnea.
diseases.cultural_management: Avoid late sowing; maintain clean field borders free of weeds.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Vector whitefly management: spray diafenthiuron 50 WP (1 g/L) or spiromesifen 22.9 SC (1 ml/L).

diseases.name: Cotton Boll Rot Complex
diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on bolls turning dark brown to black, rotting lint, and mummified bolls that fail to open.
diseases.prevention_methods: Adopt wider spacing; avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization; manage sucking pests.
diseases.biological_management: Foliar application of Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L.
diseases.cultural_management: Skip row irrigation and maintain good aeration within canopy.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray propiconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) or carbendazim 50 WP (1 g/L) during continuous rainy spells.

diseases.name: Yellow / Stripe Rust
diseases.symptoms: Yellowish-orange pustules arranged in linear parallel stripes on leaf blades, powdery urediniospores on touch.
diseases.prevention_methods: Sow rust-resistant varieties (HD 2967, HD 3086, DBW 187); timely sowing before mid-November.
diseases.biological_management: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L; application of bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis.
diseases.cultural_management: Avoid late sowing; eradicate alternate weed hosts; avoid excess nitrogen.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L (200 ml in 200L water/acre) at first appearance.

diseases.name: Karnal Bunt

diseases.cultural_management: Practice crop rotation with non-host crops (gram, mustard); avoid excess irrigation at flowering.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L at 50% ear emergence stage.

diseases.cultural_management: Follow 2-3 year crop rotation; uproot and burn affected clumps immediately; ensure proper drainage.

diseases.biological_management: Sett dipping in Trichoderma harzianum @ 10g/L before planting.
diseases.cultural_management: Avoid ratooning in affected fields; 2-year crop rotation; prompt drainage.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Sett dip in Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP @ 1 g/L.

diseases.symptoms: Yellowish-orange pustules arranged in linear parallel stripes on leaf blades, powdery urediniospores on touch.
diseases.prevention_methods: Sow rust-resistant varieties (HD 2967, HD 3086, DBW 187); timely sowing before mid-November.
diseases.biological_management: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L; application of bio-fungicide Bacillus subtilis.
diseases.cultural_management: Avoid late sowing; eradicate alternate weed hosts; avoid excess nitrogen.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L (200 ml in 200L water/acre) at first appearance.

diseases.name: Karnal Bunt
diseases.symptoms: Partial conversion of grain into black powdery masses emitting a rotten fish odor (trimethylamine).
diseases.prevention_methods: Use certified bunt-free seeds; avoid planting in historically endemic fields.
diseases.biological_management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg seed.
diseases.cultural_management: Practice crop rotation with non-host crops (gram, mustard); avoid excess irrigation at flowering.
diseases.ipm_recommendations: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L at 50% ear emergence stage.
